shots.prompt: Keep the same girl, same train, same sunset. Shot 1: medium close-up, she is looking down at the folded letter in her hands, calm breathing, restrained expression, no large pose change, manga drama still.
Shot 2: same girl, same seat. Her fingers gently touch the letter edge, eyes still down, subtle emotional tension building.
Shot 3: she slowly raises her head from the letter, eyes lift toward the sunset outside the window, warm light on her face.
Shot 4: wide shot, same girl by the window looking at sunset, letter in hand, curtain floating, full train carriage composition.
